_doc: The T-slot of 80/20's 10 series (1 inch) profiles, in mm with each inch figure in its rule. Opening, lip, width under the lips, depth and the 2 degree "drop lock" (the lips lean in, so a tightened fastener springs them flat and locks) are printed on 80/20's catalogue drawing; the floor's width is the drawing's core dimension, and the flanks follow the webs, which run along the section's diagonals. The drawn slot leaves out the rounds at the floor and the lips' tips, and the small "align-a-grooves" on the faces.
name: slot-6-8020

opening.rule: Between the lips: .256 in TYP on the drawing
opening.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

lip_thickness.rule: Lip thickness at its tip: .087 in TYP on the drawing. At the cavity's wall the lip is .093 in thick, by the drop lock's 2 degrees: the drawing's .323 depth less its .23 under the lip
lip_thickness.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

lip_angle.rule: Drop lock: the underside of each lip slopes 2 degrees, thicker toward the cavity's wall
lip_angle.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: .584 in TYP on the drawing
cavity_width.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the floor: .323 in TYP on the drawing
cavity_depth.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor, taken where the webs' straight sides would meet it: the webs are .087 in thick (TYP on the drawing) and run along the section's diagonals, so their sides cross the .323 in depth this far apart. The drawing rounds them into the core, which is .356 in across
floor_width.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks are the sides of the webs, which run from the core to the corners along the section's diagonals: 45 degrees
flank_angle.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 2-16 (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)

nut_family.rule: It takes 80/20's 10 series T-nuts (1/4-20 and others): slide-in, drop-in and roll-in
nut_family.source: 80/20 Inc., Product Catalog 24, page 8-1 and after (Fasteners) (read from a distributor's copy of the catalogue; 8020.net)
